definition: demanding immediate action; urgent
example: The exigent demands of the crisis left no time for debate.

definition: to praise enthusiastically
example: Critics extolled the film as a masterpiece.

definition: irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with
example: Strip out the extraneous details from your argument.

definition: left unplowed and unseeded; inactive
example: The field lay fallow for an entire season.

definition: silly and pointless
example: He dismissed the comment as fatuous.

definition: elaborately or excessively ornate; ruddy
example: His florid prose style obscures rather than illuminates.

definition: to bewilder or confuse
example: The trick question flummoxed the whole class.

definition: to prevent or obstruct by taking action in advance
example: She tried to forestall criticism by admitting the mistake first.

definition: excessive talkativeness, especially about trivial things
example: His garrulity at meetings slowed every decision.

definition: using pompous or inflated language
example: The grandiloquent speech impressed no one in the room.

definition: lacking significance through having been overused
example: His hackneyed metaphors put the audience to sleep.

definition: denoting a period of time that was idyllically calm and happy
example: She recalled the halcyon days of her childhood summers.

definition: the pursuit of pleasure as the highest good
example: Critics dismissed the novel as a celebration of hedonism.

definition: not conforming with accepted or orthodox standards
example: His heterodox views cost him tenure.

definition: deserving or public shameful or humiliating
example: The team suffered an ignominious defeat in the final.

definition: having little or no money
example: His impecunious years taught him the value of thrift.

definition: acting quickly without thought or care
example: Her impetuous decision to quit backfired quickly.

definition: beginning to develop or come into existence
example: She sensed the incipient tension in the room.

definition: tireless; persisting without weakening
example: She was an indefatigable advocate for the cause.

definition: wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy
example: The indolent cat barely lifted its head at feeding time.

definition: unable to be resisted or avoided; inescapable
example: Death is ineluctable.

definition: impossible to understand or interpret
example: His inscrutable expression gave nothing away.

definition: showing a casual lack of concern; nonchalant
example: Her insouciant attitude masked real worry.

definition: having or showing a tendency to be easily angered
example: Their irascible boss erupted over a misplaced comma.

definition: deserving praise and commendation
example: Her efforts to reduce waste are laudable.
